captions.detailed: This 3D model is a camera flash bounce diffuser designed to slide onto a rectangular speedlight head. It features a lower oval-like mounting collar with flat, multi-segmented vertical sides and an open bottom. The upper section consists of a bulbous, rounded dome that is sliced off at a steep angle on one side, creating a large, flat, elliptical bounce plane.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric camera flash diffuser in OpenSCAD that can be adjusted for different flash models. The design must feature a customizable mounting collar to fit the flash head dimensions (width and depth), and a bulbous dome-shaped upper diffuser body that is truncated by a flat diagonal plane to act as a bounce surface.
captions.factory: The script defines a 'diffuser' module which constructs the dome geometry using a union of three scaled and translated cylinders (left, right, and center) and a scaled sphere at the top, all configured with a low segment count ($fn) for a faceted look. A large cube is rotated 45 degrees and subtracted from this union using a difference operation to form the flat bounce plane. In the main scope, a rectangular socket is subtracted from the bottom of the diffuser assembly using a difference operation with a translated cube representing the flash unit's dimensions.
